profile.summary: Systematix Corporate Services Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides merchant banking services in India. The company provides merchant banking services, including open offers/delisting/buy-backs, IPOs/right issues, follow-on public offers, equity/debt placements, valuations, ESOP advisory, and other corporate advisory services. It also offers financing against shares and margin funding
